summary: Frontend-only verification of the mechanical refactor that moved PrepAgendaTab and RetryButton out of MeetingReport.js into /app/frontend/src/components/report/. All 4 requested items pass with ZERO React errors/warnings and no behavioural change detected. (1) PrepAgendaTab empty state renders correctly ('No prep agenda for this meeting yet.' + 'Create prep agenda' button for manager). (2) Populated state verified end-to-end after seeding a prep agenda with coverage on an in_review meeting: focus chip 'Focus: TEST_Caseload pressure', summary badges '1 Covered / 1 Partial / 10 Missed', all 7 section headings with their colour classes, per-question dots + evidence quotes + Covered/Partial/Missed pills, 'Edit prep →' link, and the amber carry-forward banner; clicking data-testid=carry-forward-btn issued POST /api/prep/{id}/carry-forward-missed -> 200 and showed the toast '10 missed questions added as actions.'. (3) RetryButton verified on BOTH paths on a processing_failed meeting: error path (no audio) rendered the backend detail 'No audio file found — please re-upload the recording'; success path (after attaching an audio_file_id) showed the disabled 'Retrying…' spinner state, POST /api/processing/{id}/retry succeeded and the page auto-refreshed ~3s later into the 'Processing your recording' stepper. (4) Smoke regression: all 6 tabs (Overview/Transcript/Compliance/Comments/Prep Agenda/Audit Trail) clickable and rendering content in the correct order; header title centred in the blue org bar; signed-off meeting shows exactly one primary action (Send to Attendees) + ••• menu containing Include-full-transcript toggle, Export PDF, Export Transcript, Share with team (Share modal opens); on an in_review meeting the Sign Off confirm modal opens and cancels cleanly and Mark Reviewed returned 200 with 'You reviewed this' appearing. Frontend is served by the CRA dev server (yarn start), so the source refactor is live — the stale-bundle caveat from iteration_69 no longer applies.

minor.issue: Pre-existing (not refactor-related): exactly one GET /api/auth/me returns 401 on every full page load, logging a console error, before the axios refresh interceptor recovers. Cosmetic but pollutes the console on every load.

action_items: No fixes required for this refactor — PrepAgendaTab and RetryButton behave identically after being moved out of MeetingReport.js.
Optional/low priority: silence the single 401 GET /api/auth/me console error emitted on every page load (pre-existing, recovered by the refresh interceptor).
critical_code_review_comments: PrepAgendaTab.js: the useEffect dependency list is [meetingId] only while it closes over API/getAuthConfig — currently harmless (stable values) and the eslint-disable is already there, but if getAuthConfig ever becomes identity-unstable/token-refreshing this will fetch with a stale config. Consider passing a memoised fetcher.

PrepAgendaTab.js has no error state: a failed GET /api/prep/{id} is swallowed by .catch(() => setPrep(null)) and renders the 'No prep agenda' empty state, which is indistinguishable from a genuine 404. Consider a distinct error/retry state.
PrepAgendaTab.js: /api/prep/{id} takes ~2s on the public ingress and the tab shows only a bare spinner during that time — fine, but note for future tests that waits under ~3s will race the render.
MeetingReport.js is now 981 lines — still above the 700-line guideline; the header/tabs extraction the user deferred is worth doing next.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. Two false alarms during the run were my own test artefacts: a spinner-only Prep Agenda screenshot (2.5s wait vs ~2s API latency + render) and a missing 'Retry started' string (the retry POST resolved after my 2.5s assertion window; the subsequent status transition to 'Processing' proved success).
